label: Synthetic population for simulation. Real ACS PUMS household records reweighted to real block-group and tract totals; not real people.
name: East Side, Buffalo, New York
source: ACS 2019-2023 5-year: PUMS (NY PUMAs 01205, 01206), B11001, B11007, B25044 by block group, B18101 by tract, from www2.census.gov bulk files. Buildings: OpenStreetMap residential buildings in the detail box, retrieved via Overpass. Care facilities: OpenStreetMap.
era: ACS 2019-2023 describes the town within a few years of the event.
assumptions: ACS has no wheelchair, bed or oxygen variables; see modeling/rollcall_d/population.py for the mapping and its rates.
